About.title: About Global Teaching Hub
About.intro: Global Teaching Hub is an online tutoring platform offering live, one-to-one classes, experienced teachers, flexible schedules, and personalized learning for students from Pakistan and around the world.
About.missionBody: To make quality, personalized education accessible to students everywhere, through live one-to-one classes with experienced, caring teachers.
About.visionBody: To become a trusted online academy where students from Pakistan and around the world can learn, grow, and achieve their goals with confidence.
About.teachersBody: Every class is led by a qualified, experienced teacher who is committed to your progress, with flexible scheduling built around your life.
About.ctaBody: Book a free demo class and experience Global Teaching Hub for yourself.

Faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
Faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about learning with Global Teaching Hub.

items.question: How do the online classes work?
items.answer: Classes are conducted live, one-to-one, over video call with a dedicated teacher. Sessions are scheduled at a time that works for you, and recordings are shared afterward so you can revisit any lesson.

items.question: Which courses do you currently offer?
items.answer: We currently offer Quran with Tajweed (including Translation and Tafseer) and Computer Courses (MS Word, PowerPoint, and Programming Languages). More courses will be added soon.

items.question: How do I book a free demo class?
items.answer: Click “Book a Free Demo” on the homepage, fill in your details and preferred course, and our team will contact you to schedule your free trial class.

items.question: What do I need to attend a class?
items.answer: A stable internet connection and a laptop, tablet, or smartphone with a camera and microphone are all you need to join a class.

items.question: How can I get in touch with support?
items.answer: You can reach us anytime through the Contact page, or via the phone number and email listed in the footer.

privacySections.title: Information We Collect
privacySections.body: When you book a free demo, contact us, or enroll in a course, we collect information such as your name, email address, phone number, and the course you're interested in. We only collect what's needed to provide and improve our services.

privacySections.title: How We Use Your Information
privacySections.body: We use your information to schedule classes, respond to your inquiries, send you relevant updates about your enrollment, and improve the quality of our teaching and support.

privacySections.title: Information Sharing
privacySections.body: We do not sell or rent your personal information to third parties. Your details are only shared with Global Teaching Hub staff and teachers directly involved in your learning experience.

privacySections.title: Data Security
privacySections.body: We take reasonable measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

privacySections.title: Your Rights
privacySections.body: You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information at any time by contacting us.

privacySections.title: Changes to This Policy
privacySections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page.

termsSections.title: Acceptance of Terms
termsSections.body: By enrolling in a course or using our website, you agree to these Terms & Conditions. If you do not agree, please do not use our services.

termsSections.title: Enrollment & Classes
termsSections.body: Class schedules are arranged based on mutual availability between students and teachers. We ask that students provide reasonable notice if a scheduled class needs to be rescheduled or cancelled.

termsSections.title: Free Demo Classes
termsSections.body: Free demo classes are offered to help you evaluate our teaching before enrolling. They are subject to teacher availability and may be limited to one per student.

termsSections.title: Fees & Payments
termsSections.body: Course fees, where applicable, will be communicated to you directly by our team before enrollment is confirmed.

termsSections.title: Code of Conduct
termsSections.body: Students and teachers are expected to treat one another with respect during classes. Global Teaching Hub reserves the right to suspend access for behavior that violates this expectation.

termsSections.title: Changes to These Terms
termsSections.body: We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time. Continued use of our services after changes are posted constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
